data.name: Jatinendra
data.long_meaning: Jatinendra is a compound name derived from Sanskrit roots Jati (birth, origin) and Indra (ruler, king of the gods). The name means 'Lord of the Earth' or 'Son of Indra'.

in_sanskrit.name: जतिनेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
जति (Jati) - birth, origin
नेन्द्र (Nendra) - lord, ruler
Therefore, Jatinendra can be interpreted as 'the lord of birth or origin of knowledge and wisdom'

in_hindi.name: जतिनेन्द्र
in_hindi.meaning:
जाति (Jati) - birth, origin
नेन्द्र (Nendra) - नेता (Netaa) + राजा (Raja) - leader + king
in_hindi.long_meaning:
जाति (Jati) से उर्जा हुई जन्म या श्रोत्रियता से जानना चाहता है नेता (Netaa) के रूप से राजा (Raja) के रूप में विज्ञान वा ग्यान का ईमादित्र (Ishwar) है।
Therefore, Jatinendra can be interpreted as 'the leader and king who desires to acquire knowledge and wisdom from the source of birth'

in_tamil.name: ஜதிநேந்திர
in_tamil.meaning:
ஜதி (Jathi) - birth
நேந்திர (Nendhir) - நேர் (Neer) + திரு (Thiru) + இரும்பு (Irumbu) - ocean, river
Therefore, Jatinendra can be interpreted as 'the one who has the power to control the ocean or river of knowledge'

in_telugu.name: జటినేద్ర
in_telugu.meaning:
జటి (Jati) - birth
ఎణ్ణద్ర (Nendra) - ఎణ్ణ (Enna) + ద్రీశ్య (Drisya) + రాజ (Raja) - lord
Therefore, Jatinendra can be interpreted as 'the one who is the lord of the source of knowledge'

vedic_reference.note: Jatinendra is a name of Lord Vishnu in Hindu mythology. He is also known as Jatavedas, the god of knowledge and wisdom. The name is derived from the root words 'Jati' and 'Nendra'.

data.cultural_impact: Jatinendra is a distinctive Hindu name with ancient origins that represents earthly power, authority, and divine connection. It stands out as a name of respect and legacy, evoking images of heroism, valor, and nobility in Indian culture, often associated with the vanquisher of Vritra, the rain-god Indra.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Jatinendra holds deep religious connotations rooted in Indian mythology. It signifies an individual's connection to and reverence for the divine energy embodied in the indomitable king of the gods, Indra. This name can serve as a reminder of the power and grace of the divine within, inspiring inner strength, courage, and resilience.

historical_references.reference: Jatinendra was the title of the 12th Jain Tirthankara, or spiritual leader, who lived around 230 BC. He was revered for his spiritual attainments and was considered an embodiment of compassion and mercy.

Jatinendra was also the name of a famous Hindu king who ruled over the kingdom of Magadha in the late 5th century AD. He was known for his patronage of art, culture, and education, and is believed to have established the famous Nalanda University during his reign.
